title: UE requested PDN connectivity procedure accepted by the network

entities.name: UE requested PDN connectivity procedure
entities.description: Procedure where UE requests PDN connectivity and network accepts it, leading to default EPS bearer context activation.

entities.name: PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to request PDN connectivity, containing parameters like APN, PDN type, and request type.

entities.name: ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by MME to activate default EPS bearer context when PDN connectivity is accepted.

entities.name: ESM information transfer flag
entities.description: Flag in PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST indicating if ESM information transfer procedure is needed.

entities.name: APN
entities.description: Access Point Name identifying the PDN to connect to. May be default, emergency, or RLOS configured.

entities.name: Request type
entities.description: Indicates type of request: initial, emergency, handover of emergency bearer services, RLOS, etc.

entities.name: Connectivity type IE
entities.description: IE indicating if PDN connection is LIPA PDN connection.

entities.name: ESM cause
entities.description: Cause values like #50 (PDN type IPv4 only allowed), #51 (PDN type IPv6 only allowed), #52 (single address bearers only allowed).

entities.name: Header compression configuration IE
entities.description: IE for header compression configuration, optionally included in PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST and ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST.

entities.name: Control plane only indication
entities.description: Indication that PDN connection is only for control plane CIoT EPS optimization.

entities.name: Timer T3482
entities.description: Timer stopped by UE upon receipt of ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message.

entities.name: PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE
entities.description: State entered by UE after stopping timer T3482 upon receipt of ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST.

entities.name: Emergency request type condition
entities.description: Condition when request type is emergency or handover of emergency bearer services, triggering use of emergency APN.

entities.name: LIPA PDN connection indication
entities.description: Property indicating PDN connection is LIPA, stored in EPS bearer context and indicated to UE upper layers.

relations.description: PDN connectivity procedure starts with receipt of PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message.
Procedure includes sending ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST when connectivity accepted.
PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST may contain ESM information transfer flag.
PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST may contain APN IE.
PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST contains request type IE.
ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST may contain Connectivity type IE for LIPA indication.
ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST may contain ESM cause for IP version restrictions.
ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST may include Header compression configuration IE.
ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST may include Control plane only indication.
Receipt of ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST stops timer T3482.
UE enters PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE state after receiving ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST.
Emergency request type condition determines use of emergency APN.
Connectivity type IE indicating LIPA establishes LIPA PDN connection property.
